simple.meaning: טִין (ṭîyn) is a Hebrew word meaning “clay.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: טִין (H2917) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 2:41, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טִין (H2917) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in טִין (H2917) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: טִין (ṭîyn) / H2917 is traced through Daniel 2:41, Daniel 2:43 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

timeline.evidenceText: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.
Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they will mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they won’t cling to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.
